event.title: Ariana Grande Withdraws from Musical, Plans to Step Back from Public Life
event.canonical_title: Ariana Grande Withdraws from Musical, Plans to Step Back from Public Life
event.summary: Ariana Grande has withdrawn from her upcoming role in the London revival of 'Sunday in the Park With George,' which was set to open in summer 2027. A representative for the singer stated that she intends to take a 'step back' from the public eye due to ongoing scrutiny. Grande is currently on tour and plans to reduce her visibility following the conclusion of her tour next month.
